text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After the race, Tokai Teio returns to the
waiting
room. However, she doesn't
seem her usual self.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I have fun racing, and I'm super happy
when I win
and get praised...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
But I just can't stop sighing. What's
wrong with
me?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's likely due to too many races
back-to-back. I
should reconsider her
race schedule.
